TheˆPlusˆplanˆPlusˆcostsˆ$5.00ˆaˆmonth.ˆIt'sˆbuiltˆforˆpeopleˆwhoˆuseˆtheirˆcardˆaˆlotˆawayˆfromˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆorˆspendˆsomeˆtimeˆabroad,ˆandˆitˆaddsˆCushionˆandˆaˆhigherˆsavingsˆrate.ˆ##ˆWhat'sˆincludedˆ-ˆ**Monthlyˆfee:**ˆ$5.00ˆ-ˆ**ATMs:**ˆfreeˆatˆBrookLinkˆATMs,ˆplusˆ3ˆfreeˆout-of-networkˆwithdrawalsˆaˆmonth.ˆAfterˆthatˆit'sˆ$2.50ˆperˆwithdrawal.ˆ-ˆ**Foreignˆtransactionˆfee:**ˆ1%ˆofˆtheˆpurchaseˆamountˆ-ˆ**Cardˆreplacement:**ˆfreeˆ-ˆ**Expeditedˆcardˆshipping:**ˆ$25.00ˆ-ˆ**SavingsˆPockets:**ˆ2.00%ˆAPYˆ-ˆ**Cushion:**ˆfee-freeˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆonˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆ-ˆ**Dailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit:**ˆ$5,000ˆ-ˆ**DailyˆATMˆlimit:**ˆ$1,000ˆ##ˆGoodˆtoˆknowˆPlusˆincludesˆoutgoingˆinternationalˆwiresˆforˆ$35.00ˆeach.ˆYourˆcardˆisˆplastic,ˆlikeˆBasic.ˆUpgradeˆtoˆPremiumˆifˆyouˆwantˆtheˆmetalˆcard.ˆYouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPlan.ˆUpgradesˆstartˆrightˆaway.ˆDowngradesˆstartˆonˆyourˆnextˆbillingˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="plans-compare">
Compareˆplans:ˆfeaturesˆandˆlimitsˆAllˆthreeˆplansˆcomeˆwithˆaˆVisaˆdebitˆcard,ˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp,ˆBrookPayˆtransfersˆtoˆotherˆmembers,ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆandˆsupportˆaroundˆtheˆclock.ˆTheyˆdifferˆinˆfees,ˆlimitsˆandˆaˆfewˆfeatures.ˆ|ˆFeatureˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆCardˆ|ˆplasticˆ|ˆplasticˆ|ˆmetalˆ|ˆ|ˆSavingsˆAPYˆ|ˆ0.50%ˆ|ˆ2.00%ˆ|ˆ3.75%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCushionˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆ|ˆupˆtoˆ$200ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆcardˆspendingˆ|ˆ$3,000ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆ|ˆ$500ˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ$1,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆACHˆtransfersˆoutˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwiresˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆ|ˆEmergencyˆcardˆabroadˆ|ˆnoˆ|ˆnoˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆFeesˆareˆlistedˆinˆtheˆarticleˆ"Feesˆforˆallˆplans".ˆThisˆpageˆcoversˆfeaturesˆandˆlimitsˆonly.ˆ##ˆWhichˆplanˆfitsˆBasicˆsuitsˆpeopleˆwhoˆmostlyˆuseˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆandˆdon'tˆtravel.ˆPlusˆsuitsˆpeopleˆwhoˆwantˆCushionˆandˆaˆbetterˆsavingsˆrateˆforˆaˆsmallˆmonthlyˆfee.ˆPremiumˆsuitsˆfrequentˆtravelersˆandˆpeopleˆwithˆlargerˆbalances,ˆsinceˆtheˆsavingsˆrateˆandˆtheˆmissingˆforeignˆfeesˆcanˆmoreˆthanˆcoverˆtheˆmonthlyˆfee.ˆYouˆcanˆswitchˆplansˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="disputes-duplicate">
ChargedˆtwiceˆforˆtheˆsameˆthingˆSeeingˆtheˆsameˆchargeˆtwiceˆdoesn'tˆalwaysˆmeanˆyouˆwereˆchargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆCheckˆifˆoneˆisˆpendingˆHotels,ˆgasˆstations,ˆcarˆrentalsˆandˆrestaurantsˆoftenˆplaceˆaˆtemporaryˆauthorization,ˆthenˆpostˆtheˆfinalˆamountˆseparately.ˆTheˆpendingˆoneˆusuallyˆdropsˆoffˆwithinˆ7ˆdays.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ##ˆIfˆbothˆhaveˆpostedˆIfˆtwoˆidenticalˆchargesˆhaveˆbothˆposted,ˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirst.ˆMostˆwillˆrefundˆaˆduplicateˆquickly.ˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆdoesn'tˆhelp,ˆdisputeˆtheˆsecondˆchargeˆinˆtheˆappˆasˆaˆduplicate.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆChargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆDuplicateˆfeesˆIfˆweˆchargedˆyouˆtheˆsameˆfeeˆtwice,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆAˆfeeˆchargedˆinˆerrorˆisˆalwaysˆrefunded.ˆ##ˆTimeˆlimitˆDuplicateˆchargesˆfollowˆtheˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwindow:ˆ120ˆdaysˆfromˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆ##ˆSplitˆpaymentsˆSomeˆmerchantsˆsplitˆoneˆorderˆintoˆseveralˆcharges,ˆforˆexampleˆwhenˆitemsˆshipˆseparately.ˆCheckˆyourˆorderˆconfirmationˆbeforeˆyouˆdispute.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
